description: Wildcard scope matching over additional boundary inputs: wildcard-only patterns of multiple segments, empty segments produced by adjacent dots, patterns with more segments than the request, and a request equal to a single dot. For each requested scope the output reports whether it is allowed.

cases.expected_output:
request=a.b allowed=true
request=a allowed=false
request=a.b.c allowed=true
request=. allowed=false
request=a. allowed=false

request=a..c allowed=false
request=a.b.c allowed=true
request=a.x.c allowed=true
request=a.c allowed=false
request=a.b.c.d allowed=false

request=a.b allowed=false
request=a.b.c allowed=false
request=a.b.c.d allowed=true

request=read.a allowed=true
request=read. allowed=false
request=read allowed=false
request=read.a.b allowed=true
